note: Screen 3 storyboard (Figma 'Storyboard · Screen 3'). Narrative framing questions, not facts.

slides.caption: A teen on a rooftop looks up at Jupiter shining in the night sky.
slides.text: Every great mission begins with a question.

slides.caption: Jupiter, Europa and Mars, each with a big "?" bubble.
slides.text: Why does Jupiter have such giant storms? What hides under Europa's ice? Was there ever water on Mars?

slides.caption: A mission team around a glowing spacecraft blueprint.
slides.text: Mission designers turn questions into spacecraft. They choose a goal, instruments, a rocket and an orbit, with a limited budget.

slides.caption: A rocket on the launch pad, Earth behind it.
slides.text: Now it's your turn. Pick a question, design your mission and bring the answers home. Every choice has a cost, for your mission and for Earth.
